meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Browse the web for any task — research topics, read articles, interact with web apps, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, and test web pages. Use whenever a browser would be useful, not just when the user explicitly asks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用浏览器自动完成网页浏览、数据提取和测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器完成各种网页任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate web browsing, data extraction, and testing with a browser
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to programmatically control a browser for web tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以自动打开浏览器，访问网页、点击按钮、填写表单、截图、提取文字和链接、保存 PDF，还能登录网站并记住登录状态。
howto.when: 当你需要 Claude 上网查资料、操作网页或测试网站时，即使你没有明确说“用浏览器”，它也会主动使用。

say.text: 帮我打开百度，搜索今天的新闻。
say.note: Claude 会打开浏览器并执行搜索。

say.text: 登录我的邮箱，查看最新邮件。
say.note: Claude 会打开邮箱页面并尝试登录。

say.text: 把这个网页截图保存下来。
say.note: Claude 会对当前页面截图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically open a browser, visit web pages, click buttons, fill forms, take screenshots, extract text and links, save PDFs, and log into websites while remembering login states.
howto.when_en: When you need Claude to research online, interact with web pages, or test websites, even if you don't explicitly say 'use the browser'.

say_en.text: Open Baidu and search for today's news.
say_en.note: Claude will open the browser and perform the search.

say_en.text: Log into my email and check the latest messages.
say_en.note: Claude will open the email page and attempt to log in.

say_en.text: Take a screenshot of this webpage.
say_en.note: Claude will capture a screenshot of the current page.
